formats.name: Tabular One Page CV
formats.summary: A dense, scan-friendly scientific snapshot with education, appointments, major awards or funding, and a tightly selected publication list.
formats.audience: Introductions, nominations, speaker dossiers, and applications that explicitly ask for a one-page academic CV.

source.title: Original Vitamine Word template
source.note: Original local design; not affiliated with an external institution.

formats.name: Short Academic CV
formats.summary: A compact conventional academic CV that balances career history with selected scientific output.
formats.audience: Academic applications, committee packets, and collaborations where a full dossier would be excessive.

source.title: Oxford Academic Applications
source.note: Structural reference only; Vitamine artwork and layout are original.

formats.name: Formal Academic CV
formats.summary: A comprehensive, chronology-heavy record for medical-faculty review, promotion, and institutional dossiers.
formats.audience: Medical-school promotion, senior faculty review, and archival academic dossiers.

source.title: Faculty of Medicine CV Guidelines
source.note: Inspired by public medical-faculty guidance. No Harvard name, logo, branding, or endorsement is included in the template.

formats.name: NIH-Style Biosketch Draft
formats.summary: A concise scientific profile centred on preparation, appointments, a personal statement, and contributions to science.
formats.audience: Internal drafting and reuse of biosketch material.

source.title: NIH Biographical Sketch Supplement
source.note: The bundled sanitized design source is a legacy Word form and must not be represented as current NIH-compliant output.

formats.name: DFG Research CV
formats.summary: A restrained four-page research-funding CV with qualitative achievements and a maximum of ten selected works.
formats.audience: German Research Foundation proposals and similar European funding applications.

quality.label: Working draft
quality.description: A functional English working template based on a successfully submitted CV; check it against the current call requirements before submission.

source.title: DFG form 53.200 elan – Curriculum Vitae
source.note: Working draft aligned to the official 07/25 section structure; users remain responsible for checking current call requirements.

formats.name: ERC CV & Track Record
formats.summary: A selective, evidence-led CV combining career information with a compact track record and brief context for major outputs.
formats.audience: European Research Council applications and other excellence-focused funding calls.

quality.label: Local preview package
quality.description: Installable in the local library as a design brief. The working Word template has not been implemented yet.

source.title: ERC Work Programme 2026 webinar
source.note: Future implementation must track the applicable call-year template and submission rules.

formats.name: Narrative Research CV
formats.summary: A modular narrative CV that foregrounds contributions to knowledge, people, research culture, and wider society rather than publication counts.
formats.audience: UKRI-style applications, interdisciplinary teams, and funders using narrative assessment.

quality.label: Local preview package
quality.description: Installable in the local library as a design brief. The working Word template has not been implemented yet.

source.title: UKRI Résumé for Research and Innovation
source.note: The official Word template is a reference; Vitamine will not redistribute it without a separate reuse review.

formats.name: Modern Publication-First
formats.summary: A clean contemporary scientist CV with a narrow profile rail and a wide main column for research themes, projects, and selected publications.
formats.audience: Lab websites, invited profiles, fellowships, and modern academic job applications.

quality.label: Local preview package
quality.description: Installable in the local library as an original design brief. The working Word template has not been implemented yet.

source.note: MIT-licensed layout ecosystem used only for visual research; this Vitamine preview is an original schematic.
